subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: token volume & peak TPS
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmecommerce.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volumes & peak TPS

Alex,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the platform looks promising and I wanted to follow up with the numbers we discussed so you can help us qualify pricing. A few quick details:

- Expected monthly token volume (estimated): 80M–120M tokens
- Typical traffic profile: steady during business hours with spikes during marketing campaigns
- Expected peak TPS: ~15–20 TPS (short bursts up to 25 TPS during spikes)
- Use case mix: ~60% chat/generation, ~40% embeddings/rerank (by token count generation-heavy)
- Budget: target spend roughly $3k–$5k/month initially; open to guidance on $/1M token targets

Can you confirm: which model tiers and unit economics would map to our volume and budget? Also, we have a security questionnaire attached — please confirm who on your side should receive it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’d like to lock in a trial and a short PoC if the numbers look right.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Director of ML Platform
Acme Commerce

Attachments: SecurQuestionnaire_filled.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@acmecommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 17:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification — token volumes & peak TPS

Thanks Sofia — great to connect. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can produce an accurate cost projection and recommended plan.

Recap of what you shared: 80–120M tokens/month, peak ~15–20 TPS (bursts up to 25 TPS), ~60% generation chat, ~40% embeddings/rerank. Budget target $3k–$5k/month.

A few clarifying points:
- Is the 80–120M an initial ramp (month 1) or steady-state expectation?
- For the chat portion, what is your average prompt+response length estimate (tokens per request)?
- Do you expect synchronous low-latency (tail latency <200ms) for production or is slightly higher latency acceptable?

Initial unit-economics / hosted guidance (high-level):
- Our hosted API pricing for generation-tier models typically maps to roughly $30–$50 per 1M tokens depending on model size and request pattern.
- For embeddings-heavy workloads we can often get to a lower effective $/1M because of different model choices and batch-friendly paths.
- For your 100M token midpoint, at $40/1M that would be ~$4,000/month. At $30/1M it would be ~$3,000/month.

Peak TPS & capacity planning notes:
- For sustained 15–20 TPS we recommend reserved capacity (Dedicated) or a hosted plan with burst capacity enabled to avoid cold-start throttles — but for initial PoC hosted can handle the bursts with minimal throttling if we provision adequate rate limits.
- If you need sub-200ms tail latency for chat, that influences the model variant we recommend and will push pricing toward the higher end.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben (cc’d) — can you prepare a short cost projection (spreadsheet) showing 80M/100M/120M tokens at $30/$40/$50 per 1M token and include the impact of peak TPS on recommended plan?
2) Sofia — confirm whether 80–120M is steady-state or ramp and give a rough tokens-per-request estimate.
3) We’ll provision trial credits and recommend a model variant for the PoC once we have the tokens-per-request and latency SLO.

Ben — I’ve attached the security questionnaire to this thread for your review. Thanks.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx

Hi Alex/Ben,

Thanks — quick answers below:
- The 80–120M is our expected steady-state after Q2 ramp (month 3+). Month 1–2 will ramp from ~20M up to that range.
- Average tokens per chat request (prompt+response): ~450 tokens (we average longer responses). Embeddings calls are smaller (~100 tokens each).
- Latency SLO: sub-300ms median is fine; sub-200ms preferred but not mandatory for the first phase.

Budget: our procurement team is targeting $3k–$5k/month in year one; if unit economics are favorable we can scale faster. The security questionnaire is attached (filled).

Happy to set a call to review the cost spreadsheet and PoC plan next week.

Best,
Sofia
